subject: Promo samples delayed at Port41 — contingency routing and reprint options
messages:
From: Kai Chen <kai.chen@stitchprint.co>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sofia Logistics <ops@sofiatransit.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Shipment PLT789 - partial hold at Port 41 / manifest attached

Hi Neha —

Sorry to lead with bad news. Container PLT789 arrived at Port 41 this morning and the local customs unit has flagged a paperwork discrepancy on the commercial invoice. They are holding the container pending clarification.

What we see so far:~
- Manifest attached (manifest_PLT789.csv) — 1,200 promo lanyards, 600 enamel pins, 200 fabric pouches.
- Photos show minor abrasion to one pallet of lanyards (approx 220 units) — I zipped photos (damage_photos_zip_0512.zip).
- Customs indicates a 24–72 hour review window; if docs are updated quickly it can move faster.

Options we can execute now:~
1) Push corrected paperwork (I can update the commercial invoice) — likely 24–72 hrs.
2) Split the load: release unaffected pallets now and route them inland to a bonded depot for redelivery to the venue (extra cross-dock fees).
3) Air freight a small VIP subset immediately (if you need guaranteed arrival before keynote). Estimated additional cost if rushed.
4) Full reprint for damaged lanyards (lead time 5 business days) — viable for non-critical quantities.

I recommend we decide within the next 6–8 hours so carriers can prepare. Attaching the manifest and photos for your team to review.

(Attachment: manifest_PLT789.csv)
(Attachment: damage_photos_zip_0512.zip)

Best,
Kai Chen
Account Manager — StitchPrint Co.
kai.chen@stitchprint.co
+1 415 555 0132

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kai Chen <kai.chen@stitchprint.co>, Sofia Logistics <ops@sofiatransit.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment PLT789 - partial hold at Port 41 / manifest attached

Team —

Thanks Kai, and thanks for the quick heads-up. This hits our VIP lanyard pool (we reserved 500 for speaker/VIP kits). Immediate asks:~
- Marcus: can you confirm budget authority to approve an air split for up to 600 VIP lanyards if we need them on-site by Friday? Please provide a ballpark cost and PO timeline.
- Jordan: hold on informing venue ops until we confirm routing — if we route split, the venue needs an updated packing list and expected arrival times.
- Monica: confirm whether any of the 220 damaged lanyards are currently allocated to VIP/reserved lists — we need to prioritize replacements.

Kai / Sofia: please push any corrected paperwork you can now; also confirm whether you can release undamaged pallets to a bonded depot for ground forwarding to the venue. If you have a fast-air quote for 500 pieces (door-to-door by Fri AM), please include it.

I want a recommendation within 4 hours. If we do air, Marcus please include expedited customs clearance fees in the ask.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Field Marketing Lead — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0246

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kai Chen <kai.chen@stitchprint.co>, Sofia Logistics <ops@sofiatransit.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment PLT789 - partial hold at Port 41 / manifest attached

Quick calc: we can approve up to $2,800 out-of-pocket for expedited air for up to 600 lanyards (door-to-door, includes customs brokerage) to meet Friday morning. If the quote comes in > $2,800 I need a justification summary for VP approval (we have limited discretionary for travel/swag).

If we choose split routing (release undamaged pallets to bonded depot for ground), add an estimated $450 cross-dock + drayage + local courier to venue. Reprint for 220 units looks like a 5-business-day lead time and $520 for rush reprint (incl rush punch/print).

Recommendation: Approve up to $2,800 for air for the 500 VIP pieces now (we can reduce to 400 if the air quote is punitive), route remainder via bonded depot, and order a 250-piece reprint to cover damage + buffer (reprint to arrive Tue). That minimizes risk for the keynote and control costs.

(Attachment: air-quote-PLT789.pdf)

—Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Sofia Logistics <ops@sofiatransit.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kai Chen <kai.chen@stitchprint.co>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment PLT789 - partial hold at Port 41 / manifest attached

Hi all —

Customs update: they performed an initial review overnight. Without additional supporting docs, they are estimating 48–72 hours to clear. If StitchPrint submits a corrected invoice with line-item HS details and a notarized packing declaration, we can escalate to a targeted audit queue (can cut time to ~24 hours).

We can also do a physical split at Port 41: release 7 pallets (undamaged) to our bonded inland depot and tender the rest for customs hold. From there we can do a next-day courier to venue (additional handling + local courier fees apply).

If you elect air for the VIP lanyards, we can pick up from Port 41 (subject to customs release) and door them to the San Francisco venue by Fri morning with overnight air — fees estimate will be around $2,200–$3,100 depending on how fast you want clearance. I will also attach the partial manifest excerpt and the photos.

(Attachment: manifest_PLT789_excerpt.pdf)
(Attachment: damage_photos_zip_0512.zip)

Regards,
Sofia Ops Team
Sofia Logistics
ops@sofiatransit.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kai Chen <kai.chen@stitchprint.co>, Sofia Logistics <ops@sofiatransit.com>, Campmate Events <ops@campmate.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment PLT789 - partial hold at Port 41 / manifest attached

Decision & next steps — final (thanks everyone for fast turnaround):~
1) APPROVED: Up to $2,800 for expedited air of VIP lanyards (target 500 units). Marcus, proceed to issue PO to StitchPrint and instruct Sofia to prioritize customs clearance paperwork.
2) SPLIT ROUTE: Release remaining undamaged pallets to Sofia's bonded depot for ground forwarding to venue. Jordan, please update the venue contact (Campmate Ops) with new ETA and a revised packing list; CC me.
3) REPRINT: Approve a 250-piece rush reprint for damaged lanyards to be shipped next Tue as a buffer — Marcus, include reprint on the same PO or create a short PO amendment.
4) ALLOCATIONS: Monica — pull VIP allocation list and mark the 500 units as the air priority; we will reassign if the air quote comes back over budget.

Kai/Sofia: please confirm expected customs clearance SLA once corrected invoice is submitted and share tracking numbers as soon as available. Also upload the final lanyard art proof used for the reprint (final_lanyard_proof_v3.pdf) to the shared folder.

Thanks — big push but this should keep keynote kits intact.

Neha Kapoor
